official.deadline_central_display: October 1: applications open. December 15: early admission deadline (CMU-Africa covers competency test fees). January 15: final application deadline - applications received after the early deadline are considered only with valid DET/IELTS/TOEFL.
official.deadline_note: The separate financial aid assessment form is completed after the admission application is submitted; applications are reviewed January-April and decisions are shared April-May.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2027 intake (applications open October 1; semester begins in September)
official.status_note: Applications are open; the early admission deadline of December 15 is the date that secures competency-test and DET fee coverage.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: "In addition to full tuition coverage, CMU-Africa provides a range of tailored resources..." and "The scholarship covers application preparation support, orientation, tuition and fees, health insurance, travel and basic living expenses, project, and entrepreneurship support." 2026-2027 tuition for African students is USD 16,000.

Resources provided: laptop, textbooks, technology fee, campus shuttle service and student life activities
Career preparation: internship and career fairs, networking with industry leaders and one-on-one career coaching
Leadership development through student clubs, community service and tailored leadership training
eligibility: Admitted to one of CMU-Africa's degree programmes (MSIT, MS ECE or MS EAI) - admission is a prerequisite for consideration
Faces the highest social and economic barriers to opportunity

requirements: Submit the online application to the MSIT, MS ECE or MS EAI programme (there is no application fee)
Complete the one-hour online technical (competency) test once the application is complete
Submit valid English proficiency scores (DET, IELTS or TOEFL); recommended minimums are TOEFL 81, IELTS 6.5 and DET 120
Complete the separate financial aid assessment form after submitting the admission application
Meet the deadline for the admission round
documents: Online application with responses to written and video essay questions
CV/resume uploaded as a PDF, at most 2 pages (additional pages are not considered)
Contact details for three recommenders (letters themselves are not required for MSIT/MS EAI applicants; MS ECE recommenders submit an online form)
Unofficial transcripts showing grades for all coursework to date, all pages in a single PDF, including a grading scale/key explanation
Official DET, IELTS or TOEFL score reports sent directly to CMU-Africa
selection_criteria: Academic talent: scholars value learning and have the drive to complete their education
Commitment to giving back: a demonstrated commitment to improving their communities
Potential to lead: scholars will become role models, mentors and change-makers
Students must first be admitted to one of CMU-Africa's degree programmes to be considered
coverage: Laptop, textbooks, technology fee, campus shuttle service and student life activities
Application preparation support, orientation, project and entrepreneurship support
application_method: Apply online through the CMU graduate admissions application portal (gradadmissions.engineering.cmu.edu)
Complete the separate financial aid assessment form after submitting the admission application
Request consideration for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program after admission
official.application_route: Apply to a CMU-Africa MS programme online, complete the competency tests, then submit the financial aid assessment form once the admission application is in.
official.citizenship_residency: African nationality - only admitted applicants of African nationality are eligible for CMU-Africa financial aid
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is designed for students from across Africa; current Scholars come from 22 nationalities and 40 percent are from Rwanda
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrolment in the MS in Information Technology, MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering or MS in Engineering Artificial Intelligence; programmes are tailored to candidates with a strong computer science or engineering background
official.duration: Master of Science degree at CMU-Africa in Kigali, beginning with the May-August Student Induction Program and the September semester start
official.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at CMU-Africa supports highly talented, service-oriented young people who face the highest social and economic barriers to opportunity as they complete Master of Science degrees in Information Technology, Electrical and Computer Engineering or Engineering Artificial Intelligence in Kigali.
official.program_type: Fully funded need-based graduate scholarship partnership between Carnegie Mellon University Africa and the Mastercard Foundation
official.english_requirement: Valid DET, IELTS or TOEFL score required (recommended minimums: TOEFL 81, IELTS 6.5, DET 120); exemption for undergraduate degrees from Carnegie Mellon University or completed in residence in the US, UK or Canada (excluding Quebec). Applications received after the December 15 early admission deadline are considered only with valid scores.

verification.notes: Coverage (full tuition, health insurance, travel, basic living expenses), the admission-first rule, African-nationality aid restriction, English requirements and the Oct 1 / Dec 15 / Jan 15 cycle were read directly from africa.engineering.cmu.edu pages on 2026-10-10. The programme publishes no single monetary award figure; 2026-2027 African-student tuition is USD 16,000 with estimated living costs of USD 345-580 per month. fully_funded is asserted because tuition, living expenses, travel and health insurance are all explicitly covered.

applicant_utility.summary: Two gates matter here: you must first be admitted to MSIT, MS ECE or MS EAI, and only admitted applicants of African nationality can access CMU-Africa financial aid including the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program. Apply by December 15 to have the competency-test and DET fees covered - applications after the early deadline are considered only with valid English scores already in hand. The award itself is genuinely comprehensive (tuition, fees, health insurance, travel, basic living expenses, laptop and textbooks), so the real work is the admission: essays including a video essay, a one-hour technical test and three recommenders.
applicant_utility.best_fit: African nationals with strong computer science or engineering backgrounds, English test scores ready, and a credible story of overcoming social and economic barriers plus community give-back.
application_readiness_checklist: Book DET, IELTS or TOEFL early and aim for TOEFL 81 / IELTS 6.5 / DET 120
Submit before December 15 to get competency-test and DET fees covered
Prepare the separate financial aid assessment form as soon as the admission application is submitted
Upload all transcript pages as a single PDF with a grading key attached
Request score-sends early - CMU-Africa does not accept self-reported DET or TOEFL scores
Draft the video essay as deliberately as the written essays
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the scholarship can be applied for directly - admission to a degree programme comes first
Non-African nationality, since financial aid is restricted to admitted African nationals
Applying after December 15 without English scores in hand
A weak CS or engineering background - the programmes are explicitly tailored to those profiles
A CV exceeding two pages or transcripts split across multiple files
Applying to more than one programme - you may only apply to one
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: For non-scholars or partial-need students, the gap between aid and the cost of attendance: African-student tuition is USD 16,000 for 2026-2027 plus estimated living costs of USD 345-580 per month.
document_audit: Unofficial transcripts must include every page in a single PDF plus a grading scale explanation
Final-year applicants need transcripts covering at least three-quarters of the degree programme
TOEFL institution code is 2074; IELTS scores are sent to CMU's Pittsburgh address - allow several days for verification
Name or email mismatches between your application and test accounts can break score linking
alerts: There is no application fee, but technical-test and early DET fees are only covered if you apply by December 15
Only fall intake is available; deferral is possible only after enrolment and is non-renewable
GRE is not required and will not be considered
English exemptions apply for CMU degrees or degrees completed in residence in the US, UK or Canada (excluding Quebec)
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the online application with essays and recommenders by December 15 (early) or January 15 (final), sit the one-hour technical test after submission, then complete the financial aid assessment form; decisions arrive April-May.
